topic: Parts of the Microscope and their Functions
key_concepts: A microscope magnifies objects to show detail
The word microscope comes from Greek words meaning small and to see or look
The eyepiece or ocular is a secondary lens with 10x magnification
The body tube supports the eyepiece and main optical components
Objective lenses are primary lenses with magnifications from 4x to 100x
The revolving nosepiece holds and rotates the objective lenses
The stage is the platform where the slide is placed
The stage clip keeps the slide in place
The coarse adjustment knob moves the stage up and down for initial focusing
The fine adjustment knob is used for fine focusing to get a clearer view
The diaphragm controls the amount of light reaching the specimen
The mirror or illuminator supplies light through the stage to the specimen
